name: ol-games
description: :video_game: Game stuff for Openlayers, powered by HTML5, canvas, javascript and Openlayers.

paragraphs: One hand, many games use maps as playground and some are based on a map. On the other hand, OpenLayers is a high-performance, feature-packed library for creating interactive maps on the web.

This project aims to test and add game mechanisms within Openlayers (ol). It is by no means a complete game or complete game engine but you should find some stuff to devleopp game on a map with Openlayers.
